items.title: Amway Commerce And Checkout Domain Primer
items.description: A public-source business primer and a practical model for understanding cart, checkout, post-checkout, account, and profile data in an Amway Next Gen checkout pod.

items.title: Amway Next Gen Checkout Project Technology Stack
items.description: An onboarding and architecture map for a Java 21 and Quarkus checkout stack using PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Argo CD, Dynatrace, SonarQube, and JaCoCo.

items.title: Build A Failure-Aware Checkout Service With Quarkus
items.description: Hands-on capstone modeling account and profile context, idempotent checkout, PostgreSQL transactions, outbox events, Kafka outcomes, authorization, testing, and recovery in Quarkus.
